{{Top|leg}}
The '''seismic wave emitter''' was a weapon located on the bow of a [[Protodeka]], and was used to clear enemy vehicles out of its immediate vicinity. The pulse was able to disable [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], leaving the enemy targets vulnerable to the Protodeka's [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This weapon was used by the Protodeka, a boss-type vehicle appearing in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']].
